post.description: Public endpoint dedicated to ClickUp. Preferred authentication for ClickUp API webhooks is ClickUp's `X-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 signature, configured from the ClickUp webhook Secret. The integration is resolved by matching the signature against active ClickUp integration secrets. Legacy automation clients may still send `Authorization: Bearer <webhook_token>`, `X-Integration-Token: <webhook_token>`, or `?token=<webhook_token>`. Only a processed payload is stored; the raw body is represented by `payload_hash` and `payload_size_bytes` for audit/debug. Key ClickUp fields are extracted into `normalized_payload`; mapped status-completion events can generate delivery metrics.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: ClickUp HMAC-SHA256 signature computed with the webhook Secret. Required when no legacy token is sent.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional webhook token for ClickUp configurations that cannot send custom auth headers.

post.description: Public endpoint dedicated to GitHub operational lake ingestion. Preferred authentication is GitHub's `X-Hub-Signature-256` HMAC-SHA256 signature, configured from the GitHub webhook Secret. The integration is resolved by matching the signature against active GitHub integration secrets. Legacy clients may still send `Authorization: Bearer <webhook_token>`, `X-Integration-Token: <webhook_token>`, or `?token=<webhook_token>`. Only a processed payload is stored; the raw body is represented by `payload_hash` and `payload_size_bytes` for audit/debug. GitHub events mapped for KPI analysis include pull requests, pull request reviews, check runs, check suites, workflow runs, and deployment statuses.

parameters.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
parameters.description: GitHub HMAC-SHA256 signature computed with the webhook Secret. Required when no legacy token is sent.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Legacy optional webhook token. Do not use it for new GitHub webhooks.

200.description: GitHub event accepted and stored without generating delivery metrics.

403.description: Integration is inactive or the GitHub signature is invalid.
